batting.name: CA Pujara
batting.dismissal: c CM Gautam b CJ Anderson

batting.name: GJ Maxwell
batting.dismissal: c BR Dunk b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: GJ Bailey
batting.dismissal: c CJ Anderson b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: DA Miller
batting.dismissal: c BR Dunk b SL Malinga

batting.name: BR Dunk
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b Sandeep Sharma

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b L Balaji

batting.name: CJ Anderson
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b R Dhawan

balls.text: a strong finish from Malinga, only three runs off the final over, Johnson tried to paddle a full and straight ball and ended up making no proper contact, the ball dropped on the pitch in front of him. Saha wanted to run but Johnson did not know where it was and stayed rooted to his spot
Saha swings across the line and gets an inside edge towards deep backward square leg
Saha hits the ball towards long on and Johnson comes sprinting back for the second, superb running

two dots and now a wicket, this is an exceptional final over from Malinga, Miller has struggled against Malinga and this time he ended up hitting a low full toss with the bottom of the bat, mis-timing it towards long on. Ben dunk ran in quickly and dived forward to catch the ball. Terrific take
Miller's missed out on this one, it was a higher full toss but he once again swung and was beaten, a costly miss, two dots to start the final over
a low full toss outside off, nearly a yorker, Miller swings across the line and swings on top of the ball, he misses it
a full ball, nearly in the blockhole but not quite, Saha brings his bat down hard and hits it towards cow corner, Ben Dunk sprints to his left from long-on and dives to save the boundary
a slower ball outside off, Miller reaches for it far outside off and drives it to deep cover
a full toss outside off stump, that's in Miller's arc and he slams it far over the long-off boundary

Zaheer attempts a yorker but gets his line wrong just a little - outside leg stump - Miller opens up his stance and swings across the line, the ball brushes the back leg and goes between the legs to the fine leg boundary. Zaheer seems to have injured his shoulder while bowling that delivery
short of a length outside off, Saha stays back and drives the ball over cover
short ball and Saha gets to fifty by swivelling and pulling into the stands at deep square leg, he may have started slow but he's made that start count
full and straight, Malinga's bowled a terrific over, Saha can only drive the ball along the ground to the fielder on the edge of the circle at cover
Saha swings across the line at a low full toss and was beaten, that just missed leg stump
a full ball on middle and leg, Miller chips it towards long on for a single
Saha makes room by moving outside leg and slogs across the line, mis-timing it towards deep square leg
a low full toss outside off, Miller drives on the front foot to long off, Pollard is the fielder so no more than one
a length ball on middle and leg, slightly slower, Saha pulls to deep square leg, just the single though
that's a horrible ball, and more so when your fine leg is in the circle, Miller swivelled and paddled a length ball from outside leg stump past the fielder and to the fine leg boundary, piece of cake
a slower ball and Miller defends with a straight bat
short of a length on the hips, Miller nudges the ball and once it passes the fielder in the circle at midwicket there's enough time to return for the second
short of a length and Saha pulls to deep square leg
Miller gets on to the front foot and punches the ball through cover for a single
Saha moves forward and dabs the ball through point for a single
Saha moves outside leg to make room and cuts to Zaheer at short third man
caught at deep square leg! Bailey slog sweeps but mis-times it woefully, Anderson comes running in and then stoops to catch the ball with fingers pointing up even though it was a low take
short ball and Bailey pulls to deep square leg, Pollard runs to his right on the boundary, picks up with one hand and fires the throw in
Bailey goes back and pulls the ball straight to midwicket
Saha steps out but is beaten in the flight, he dabs towards point and runs
Bailey dabs the ball close on the off side and responds to Saha's call ... the keeper does the fielding
superb placement from Saha, dragging the ball from outside off, pulling it over the infield and into the gap on the deep midwicket boundary
a full ball outside off stump, driven through cover point for a single
cut hard off the back foot, the fielder at point dives to his left but can't stop it, that will be a boundary, Bailey makes up for three dot balls
good length angling into the right hander from round the wicket, Bailey stays in his crease and plays to cover
Bailey makes room to hit on the off side but mistimes it towards midwicket
good length just outside off stump, Bailey tries to steer the ball to third man but misses
this time he gets down low and pulls the ball flat and hard, Anderson is on the deep backward square leg boundary but the ball beats his jump ... Saha making up ...
mid-off is in the circle so Saha steps out and lofts a short of a length ball over the in field, sharp awareness of where the field is
good length angling into off stump, Bailey waits in his crease and dabs towards third man
a slower ball on off stump, Bailey defends towards the bowler
Saha swats the ball through square leg for a single
that's a poor ball, outside leg stump with fine leg in the circle, Saha swings across the line and helps it along to the fine leg boundary
Saha reaches for a length ball outside off and cuts towards third man
dabbed off the back foot towards third
Saha waits for the slower ball and dabs it towards third man
Saha gets beaten by one that seams across him close to off stump, he was trying to run the ball to third man
Bailey cuts off the back foot in front of point this time
a first-ball four for Bailey, Anderson offered him so much width outside off, Bailey reached for it and opened the face to let the ball run off the face to the backward point boundary
Saha tries a cute little reverse dab, it does not come off

caught at long on! Maxwell's gone and Mumbai are ecstatic. Maxwell came down the track but didn't get to the pitch of the ball, he went through with the shot and mis-hit it straight to Ben Dunk on the boundary. Perhaps the pressure of no runs from Saha got to him in the end ...
Saha steps out and flicks the ball to deep square leg
Saha has hit a six! Got down on one knee and slog swept the ball flat over deep square leg. That came out of nowhere.
driven to long on for a single
Mazwell charges the offspinner and slams the ball over long off, he's got it all to do for Kings XI, getting no support from Saha
a length ball, slow outside off stump, Maxwell pulls to deep midwicket
Maxwell heaves at the ball but mis-times it through midwicket, Maxwell races back for the second to keep strike
a very slow ball from Pollard and Saha was hopelessly beaten, his struggle is damaging for Kings XI
Maxwell misses the reverse swat and gets hit on the leg, Pollard roars an appeal but the impact was outside off stump
Maxwell doesn't have much pace on the ball to work with - slower one from Pollard - but he manages to slap it towards wide long off and they take two to Malinga
that's wide outside off stump, and the umpire calls it ... Mawell played no shot
a slower ball, Saha moves across and dabs the ball towards midwicket for a single
a friendly full toss outside off stump, easy pickings for Maxwell, who drives the ball to the extra cover boundary
Saha's attempt at paddle sweeping ends up at square leg, he needs to find a way to get to a run a ball ...
Saha slogs wildly but the ball goes off the toe end of the bat towards the bowler
Maxwell slogs across the line but is beaten by the flight, the ball goes close on the leg side
glanced off the pads through square leg
nicely flighted on middle stump, nudged off the front foot on the leg side
just when you think the yorker is going to creep below the bat, Saha manages to play it out towards square leg and keep strike
Saha keeps out another yorker, Malinga seems to have found his groove
Malinga thinks the ball has hit the boot before the bat, the umpire does not. Malinga bowled a perfect yorker but Maxwell was good enough to keep it out and get a single towards point
the slower short ball and Maxwell pulls furiously, almost finished the shot before the ball got to him
that's a yorker but Maxwell jumps outside leg stump to hit down the ground and gets an inside edge on it that beats the keeper, boundary to long stop
Malinga drops short and Maxwell carts him, swivelling and pulling off the front foot far over the deep midwicket boundary
Maxwell strides forward and punches the ball firmly towards long off
driven on the front foot to long on for a single
chipped over the fielder at cover for a single
what's happened there? Maxwell was beaten in the flight but he went through with the lofted slice and took one hand off the bat after he made contact, the ball beat the fielder on the cover boundary
tossed up outside off stump, Saha dabs the ball towards Zaheer at short third man, Maxwell sprints the single
tight length on middle stump, Maxwell pushes towards long on and runs
defended on the off side, Bumrah ends the over well after beginning with a no-ball and a boundary
Saha is beaten on the cut as the ball darts into him from outside off stump
Maxwell moves across his stumps and flicks extravagantly to deep square leg
Maxwell gets beaten on the pull, the ball was too full and it lobbed over the stumps off the body
Maxwell aims to cart the ball for six over midwicket but missed, the ball was on a good length outside off stump
a full toss outside off stump, Maxwell slipped to one knee as he hit it but managed to place the ball wide of the man at mid-off
short and wide outside off, Maxwell hits it hard into the ground and the fielder at point has to leap to field it, Bumrah had overstepped so a free hit is coming up
good length on off, Saha gets behind the line and defends on the off side
good length on middle and off, Saha gets on the front foot and plays on the leg side
short of a length outside off stump, Saha swishes and misses
a poor line with fine leg in the circle, full and on the pads, Saha glances it to the boundary
a slower ball around off stump, played with an open face towards backward point
good length and straight, played off the pads through square leg
played back to the bowler on the back foot
a full toss on the pads flicked to deep square leg for a single
defended on the off side
goes wide of the crease and fires the ball in at middle stump, Saha stays in his crease and defends on the leg side
Saha drops the ball close on the on side, Maxwell wants one, Saha says no
played off the back foot towards point

a length ball on leg and middle, Maxwell moves forward and across and plays a checked on-drive of sorts, the ball travelled flat through the air and fell a few metres short of the man on the edge of the circle
that's much too wide outside off stump
Maxwell sees the full ball wide outside off stump, he moves forward and flays at it, carving the ball over cover point to get going with a boundary
good length around off stump, Maxwell stays in his crease and plays the ball towards point

Pujara's cameo is over! Anderson gave him lots of width again and the ball seamed across him from over the wicket, Pujara chased after it and tried to drive through cover but got an edge through to the keeper
lots of width outside off stump but Pujara's square drive does not beat point
that's so gorgeous, not the half-volley Anderson bowled outside off but the drive through extra cover from Pujara
steered to third man for a single
Zaheer goes round the wicket and bowls on the pads, Pujara glances but can't beat the man at short fine leg
a length ball outside off stump and Pujara sends it racing to the cover boundary with a flowing drive on the front foot, split the gap between two fielders in the circle

good length outside off, Saha pushes with soft hands on the off side and runs, there's a throw at the bowler's end but it misses, Rohit was moving in to collect the throw and he collided with the umpire, he seems to be winded a bit
nudged off the pads on the leg side for a single

Sehwag's been run out! He cut the ball firmly to point where the fielder dived to his right and half-stopped the ball. Rohit moved to his left from cover, picked up the ball with his left hand, transferred it to his right as he turned around and threw down the stumps at the bowler's end. Sehwag was well short. He had hesitated to run until the first fielder made his stop so that delay cost him
left alone outside off stump
that ball has bounced sharply from short of a length and jagged back in at Pujara, cutting him in half between bat and body, the keeper thought there was an inside edge but there wasn't
that's a wide outside off stump this time
that's a graceful shot from Pujara and well timed, he got on to the front foot and drove a wide ball on the up through cover
Pujara gets beaten by a full and wide ball outside off
good length and the ball skids on to Sehwag, cramping him for room and time, Sehwag fends at it and gets an inside edge on to his body, they run a single after the ball goes close on the off side
Bumrah goes wide of the crease and sprays the ball down leg, the keeper dives well to collect but can't prevent a bye
the first ball is full and fast, speared into Pujara's pads, he misses the ball and is hit on the pad but that was missing leg
opens the face a bit later this time to guide the ball behind point towards third man
short of a length outside off, Pujara stays back and cuts but does not beat the man at point
a fuller ball around off stump, Pujara leans forward and punches to cover
moves forward and defends a good length ball on the off side
too full and on the pads, Pujara immediately gets forward and across to flick the ball crisply, hitting it in the air and to the square leg boundary
good length with some width outside off as the ball angles across the right-hander from over the wicket, Pujara strides forward and lets it pass

he's done it! Pollard has ended Mumbai's run of defeats. He's done it by lofting a length ball lean over the long off boundary. The Wankhede erupts, Mumbai did not lose here last season, they have kept that streak going
a full toss to complete a shocker from Johnson, Pollard drives it to long on and settles for the single to keep strike
Pollard you beauty! Johnson has been torn apart. Pollard pulled at a slower ball, and made good enough contact to beat the fielder on the square leg boundary.
the yorker, but it's gone for four! Johnson fired in the yorker from round the wicket, Pollard jammed his bat down on it and the ball goes off the inside edge to the fine leg boundary
a slower ball, but Pollard checks his shot and manages to dab it towards square leg, Pollard comes back for the second before the fielder in the deep can rush in to field the ball
he goes full, not short, misses the yorker by a little, Pollard hits the low full toss to deep midwicket and comes back for the second ...
short ball but it's mis-directed down leg side, that's a wide. Will Johnson be able to keep it together? Mumbai seem to be favourites now ...
Pollard's clobbered this! You cannot bowl full to him. Pollard makes room by moving outside leg and launches the ball powerfully over the long-on boundary
that's a stunning finish to the over from Tare, he's dragged Mumbai back into this! He charges the final ball, which is a harmless length delivery, and pulls it over the deep midwicket boundary
Tare uses the width outside off stump to cut the ball towards the point boundary, where Akshar Patel fields
full ball outside off stump, driven to long off, Pollard hasn't attempted a big shot yet
short of a length, cramping the batsman for room, Tare mis-times the pull down the ground
that's outstanding placement! Tare latches on to a full ball outside off and lofts inside out to the extra cover boundary, almost went all the way for six
Tare makes room and chips the ball to wide long on, Pollard strides back for the second
a full ball on middle and leg, Tare stays back and dabs to midwicket to take the strike net over. Kings XI will not mind that
a low full toss on off stump, Pollard can't get under it and ends up hitting it through square leg
Anderson fails to see it through! He tries to hit a good length ball over the long-off boundary and doesn't connect properly. Miller is ready and waiting for the catch
very full and rather wide outside off stump, Anderson is too far away from the ball to reach it, I think the bowler is lucky to get away with that
a full ball on middle stump, Pollard chips it over midwicket, falls well short of the man in the deep
full and wide outside off, Anderson reaches for it and hits the ball to long off
this time he's beaten! Pollard pushes forward at a good length ball outside off and is beaten by the seam movement
Pollard lets his first ball go! Good length outside off and Pollard plays  a Test-match leave
a low full toss outside off, Anderson drives through point for a single

Saha takes an easy catch! Rohit backed away to leg and closed the face to play the ball through square leg. He played too early and the ball lobbed tamely off the leading edge behind the wicket to Saha
a length ball and Rohit heaves across the line, the ball goes quickly to the deep square leg boundary of the thick inside edge

too slow for Anderson, who had swung at the length ball before it reached him, the ball hit his stomach and dropped on the pitch, Rohit rushed through to get on strike. There's a hold up in play after that delivery, I think they were checking if the batsmen had obstructed Balaji as he tried to get to the ball. It looks okay.
played to deep midwicket for a single, Johnson has completed an exceptional over

Johnson goes very wide of the crease from round the wicket and bowls a slower ball that goes between Anderson's legs as he tries to hit on the leg side, Anderson then went out of his crease and didn't seem to know where the ball was. The keeper's throw missed the stumps by a long way
a low full toss, Anderson swings and hits the ball behind square leg, Pujara runs to his right from fine leg and dives to save the four
banged in short, Anderson backs away and hooks, Johnson follows him and beats him
a full ball outside off, Anderson opens up his stance and swings hard, mis-times the ball towards mid off
a full toss on the pads outside leg, Anderson swung across the line and missed, Johnson makes an absurd half appeal
Bailey dives to his left at backward point to cut off a Rohit steer and save the single
shot! Rohit moves across, gets down on one knee and scoops the ball over short fine leg, superb planning and execution
in the blockhole outside off stump, Anderson reaches for it and ends up bottom edging it into the pitch, Rohit knows he can beat Balaji on the sprint to the other end and he does so
angles into the pads, Rohit nudges the ball towards backward square leg and hurries through for a single
Rohit stays in his crease and mis-hits a good length ball towards the bowler
good length angling into Anderson, Rohit nudges towards the leg side, he's going to play the anchor
that's 20 off the over! Anderson slog sweeps and hits it past the fielder in the circle at square leg, Patel ends his spell with a shocker. Didn't seem to vary his deliveries at all
awful bowling this, flat with width outside off, Anderson smashes it flat over the bowler's head for four more
that's gone as well! Mumbai gaining ground this over. Anderson opens up his stance and slogs the ball into the stands beyond cow corner
Anderson sees the width on offer outside off, the trajectory is flat as well, he biffs it flat over the bowler's head for a one-bounce four
Rohit stays in his crease and plays a tight delivery towards cover for a single, that was on a good length on middle
a full toss on the pads, driven to wide long on for a single
a slower ball outside off, hit to long off for a single
a length ball and that's disappeared over long on! Anderson just lined it up and freed his arms, Pujara's on the boundary but the ball sails over him ...
that was so close to off stump! Slightly slower from Dhawan, Anderson backed away towards leg to cut and was beaten
Anderson jumps outside leg to hit through the off but can't beat mid-off
good length on off and middle, Rohit dabs it through square leg and they run a single
short and wide, a rare lose ball from Dhawan, third man is in the circle too, Rohit slashes hard, carving the ball over the third-man boundary
Rohit makes room by moving outside leg and drives the wicket-to-wicket ball through extra cover
that's a short ball, Anderson misses out, he mistimed the pull to deep midwicket
over the wicket, length ball outside off, Anderson waits on the back foot and cuts firmly to deep point
that was slower and outside off, driven through point for a single
flatter, shorter and quicker, Rohit goes back and plays the ball to the bowler
Rohit tries to turn the ball on the leg side but is hit on the pad, that was sliding past leg
Anderson drives hard at a good length ball that pitches around off and angles away from him, he is beaten. Poor footwork
good length around off stump, Anderson plays the ball to point where the fielder fumbles but doesn't concede a run

lbw! One cute reverse shot too many from Gautham. Dhawan kept it simple, wicket to wicket and on a good length. Gautham tried to reverse swat off the back foot and he missed. The ball hit him plumb in front
makes room and dabs the ball straight to short third man, Balaji is unable to save the single
played off the back foot towards the bowler
good length and the ball seems to straighten after pitching on middle, Rohit defends
there's a direct hit at the non-striker's end from deep midwicket but Rohit has run hard and is safe. Maxwell was the fielder
worked off the back foot through midwicket for a single
nudged on the leg side, Patel moves to his right to field
tries to play the reverse pull but misses and is hit on the pad
steps out but is beaten in the flight, played back to the bowler
defended on the front foot towards the bowler
good length on the pads, Gautham nudges towards square leg and runs, Johnson has to come in from the deep to field but he is quick enough to prevent the second
nudged towards midwicket, they begin to run and then stop, Maxwell picks up and throws at the striker's end, he misses, the batsmen decide against the overthrow
a length ball and Gautham lifts it off his pads towards cow corner, Miller runs to his left from long-on to field
tried to bash the ball through the off side but mis-timed it to cover, nearly carried to the fielder
pitches on a length and nips into Gautham, who is caught on the crease and hit on the thigh
a length ball outside off stump, Rohit opens the face and steers to third man, strolls the single
goes back and works the ball off the pads through midwicket ...
another reverse paddle, shouts of catch but it falls well short of short third man
nudged between point and cover for a single
flat and short, Rohit knows where the field is so he moves towards the off side and paddles the ball into the huge vacant space at fine leg
pushed into the off side for a single
Gautham brings up the fifty by playing a reverse dab fine to the third man boundary, that went off the glove and arm but beat the keeper and short third man
driven back to the bowler, Johnson picks up and hurls the ball at the striker's end, hitting the stumps
a length ball and Rohit plays a graceful lofted drive over extra cover for a one-bounce four

there's a huge mix-up but Kings XI make a big mess of it! Rohit drops the ball close on the off side and Gautham sets off, Rohit sends him back very late. Miller fields near point and throws the ball back to Johnson who is in front of the stumps. Johnson makes an utter mess of it and misses the stumps
Johnson goes round the wicket to angle the ball into the right-hander and then strays down leg side. Saha thinks the ball brushed something. Johnson does too.
Gautham moves back and across and dabs the ball as it slants across him towards third man
short and wide outside off, Rohit cuts and the ball gets to the fielder at third man on the first bounce
Rohit tries to drive on the off side but gets an inside edge towards midwicket
he's carted this over deep midwicket! Moving across his stumps to get inside the line of the length ball and hoisting it into the stands. Mumbai on their way now.
when Sandeep gets his length right his late swing has troubled the batsman. Another one hits the pad
why does he play shots like 4.2 when he can play like this? He spotted the slower ball, came forward and drove gracefully over the extra cover boundary, timing it superbly
a late inswinger hits the front pad again, seemed like a decent shout for lbw but the umpire was not interested
what on earth was that? Sandeep dug it in short, Gautham moved across his stumps and tried to scoop it over the man at short fine leg, he ended up playing it into the ground and towards slip. Ugly.
Sandeep hits the front pad again with the ball that swings into the right-hander, that was a bit high though
that's a short ball and Rohit pulls, he might have got more of a top edge on the ball than the middle off the bat but it was good enough to send the ball into the stands at backward square leg
good length on middle and off, Rohit leans forward and plays the ball back to the bowler
short of a length and at the body, Rohit stays back and plays the ball off his toes towards square leg, that hit high on the bat
Rohit has quick hands and he uses them to cut hard into the ground and towards point
good length on middle and off, Rohit gets behind the line and defends
Gautham moves back and across to steer a length delivery slanting across him towards third man
Rohit stays in his crease and clips the ball to cover

lbw! That ball snaked late into the right-hander, bending sharply from far outside off stump, Rayudu had moved across his crease and was right in front of the stumps when the ball crashed into his front pad below the knee roll. Plumb.
a full ball swings into the right-hander and goes off the inside edge through square leg
this time he steps out to pull but misses and is hit on the body
replies with the bouncer, Gautham tries to ramp it over the keeper but misses
look at that! Gautham moves so late across his stumps and the scoops the ball over the head of the man at short fine leg, the bowler did not have time to adjust his length
that's wide down leg side

edged between between first and second slip for four! Rayudu drove in hope at that ball, the length was not right for the drive and it seamed away from him, taking the outside edge and beating the fielder at first slip - Sehwag - on his right hand
Rayudu moves forward to try and attack the ball but lets it go after it pitches on a good length and seams away from him
a full and straight delivery, Rayudu moves forward and across and drills it past mid-on for four
mis-timed on the leg side for a single

that's a terrific effort from Akshar Patel but it will have to go down as a drop. Gautam moved across his stumps and flicked, the ball seamed away from him and went off the leading edge high over extra cover. Patel sprinted after it from mid-off, covering lots of ground, doing superbly to get to the ball as it dropped over his head. he seemed to catch it too, but the ball fell out of his hands after he hit the ground
angles into the right-hander, pitches on a good length outside off, and then nips away from Gautam, who lets it go
fullish delivery outside off, Rayudu plays the ball to mid off

that's an outstanding catch from Saha! He's having a good game! Dunk drove away from his body at one that swung away from him on a good length outside off stump, the edge flew quickly but Saha dived to his left to take it smoothly
a full ball on the pads, slanting down leg, Sharma appeal for what I have no idea, Gautam did not make proper contact with the flick
pushed off the front foot to wide mid-off for a single, there's a direct hit at the bowler's end but the batsman is safe and they don't run off the ricochet
better length outside off stump, movement away from the left-hander, Dunk moves forward and lets it go
a full ball outside off stump, Ben Dunk gets on to the front foot and drives through extra cover to get this chase going. A loose ball and it was put away
